structure.description: Sticky top bar showing system heartbeat, Autonomous Live Trading status (ACTIVE/PAUSED/ERROR), Active Mode (OFF/SPOT/FUTURES toggle & selector), Bot State machine (ANALYZING -> WAITING -> SIGNAL -> EXECUTING -> MANAGING -> PAUSED), Latency indicator, and Emergency Kill Switch trigger.
Compact horizontal status badges showing 6 endpoints: Delta REST, Public WS, Private WS, Market Data, News Stream, and Account Stream with LIVE/CONNECTED/STALE/UNAVAILABLE states.
Dense 8-stat grid: Real Equity (INR/USD), Available Margin, Realized P&L, Unrealized P&L, Today Net P&L, Today Fees, Open Positions count, Open Orders count.

structure.section: Core Intelligence Split (3 Columns on desktop)
structure.description: Left: 'Bot Brain' Current Market Analysis (per symbol score radar, technical/structure/order-flow/panic meters, LLM/Algo confidence score, and clear DECISION badge). Center: 'Live Market Events' Flash crash detector, panic selling/buying gauges, whale transaction detector. Right: 'Live Autonomous Decision Feed' real-time chronological timeline with millisecond precision and rule justifications.
Tab 1: Active Positions & Working Orders table. Tab 2: Autonomous Risk Limits & Strategy Weight Tuners. Tab 3: Emergency Action Center (Cancel Open Orders, Emergency Close All, Freeze Trading).

components.name: AutonomousStatusBar
components.purpose: Displays current running status, trading mode, engine state step pills, and emergency stop button.

components.name: ConnectionHealthBar
components.purpose: Renders real-time ping/health badges for Delta REST, Public WS, Private WS, Market Data, News, and Account.

components.name: AccountMetrics
components.purpose: Renders real-time financial stats with profit/loss color coded badges and tooltips.

components.name: BotBrainAnalysis
components.purpose: The core 'What the bot is seeing & thinking' panel: symbol selector (BTCUSD, ETHUSD, SOLUSD), regime, technical score, volume score, panic level, confidence meter, and Final Decision card.

components.name: LiveMarketEvents
components.purpose: Monitors anomaly events like flash dumps, liquidation cascades, volume spikes with severity meters (CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE).

components.name: DecisionTimelineFeed
components.purpose: Real-time scrollable terminal stream of bot thought iterations: Observation -> Filter -> Validation -> Signal -> Execution with telemetry tags.

components.name: PositionsAndOrders
components.purpose: Displays live open positions (symbol, side, size, entry, mark, unrealized PnL, liquidation price) and working orders.

components.name: RiskAndStrategyConfig
components.purpose: Interactive inputs for max daily drawdown, max leverage, position sizing cap, stop-loss strictness, and weight sliders for Technical / Order-flow / Sentiment / Volatility.

components.name: LiveTradingModal
components.purpose: High-friction safety modal with real-money risk disclosure, capital warning, typed confirmation string ('ENABLE REAL CAPITAL'), and toggle activation.

components.name: EmergencyControls
components.purpose: Subordinate emergency action zone: Stop Autonomous Loop, Cancel Open Orders, Panic Close All with modal verification.

anti_ai_design_rules.do_not_use_generic_cards: Use 1px border-slate-800 with bg-[#0D1117] and inset highlight border. Never use generic white cards with drop shadows.
anti_ai_design_rules.never_use_ai_emojis: Forbidden: 🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮, 🎯, 🚀. Use technical glyphs, SVG icons (lucide-react Activity, ShieldAlert, Cpu, Terminal, Zap, Radio, Sliders, AlertTriangle).
anti_ai_design_rules.honesty_rule: If API key or data feed is simulated or offline, display explicit 'UNAVAILABLE / DISCONNECTED' badge in amber/red. Never render fake live green ticks when disconnected.
anti_ai_design_rules.dense_metrics: Use mono font JetBrains Mono for all numbers, decimal places, and timestamps. Use 2 decimal places for INR/USD, 4 for crypto prices.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep files in React JSX (.js) format since this is a Create React App / CRACO setup with .js files.
2. Ensure all interactive buttons, selects, and inputs have exact data-testid attributes specified.
3. Implement full state management: User can switch modes (TRADING OFF / SPOT / FUTURES), tweak risk limits, trigger the Scary Real-Money Enable flow, test emergency stop, and filter decision logs.
4. Connect realistic mock engine loop that simulates autonomous tick updates every 2-3 seconds when bot is ACTIVE so the user sees the Bot Thinking cycle in real-time.
5. Provide pre-configured endpoints for Delta Exchange India (/v2/tickers, /v2/orders, /v2/products) with clear API credential input settings tab or modal.
6. Ensure all contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit hover and active states.
